# Iman Golriz

Official website: https://solitary-field-af31.imangolrizimangolriz.workers.dev/
Name: Iman Golriz (ایمان گلریز)
Roles: Interdisciplinary artist, arts researcher, writer, and university instructor.
Founder of: Liminism (مکتب لیمینیسم), a philosophical and artistic approach focused on lived liminal experience, threshold states, in-betweenness, and suspension.
Main fields: Philosophy of art, interdisciplinary arts, theatre, acting, music, painting, dramaturgy, literature, and arts research.
Published books listed on the website: five titles related to liminal experience, music and the actor's body, cinematic suspense, Liminism, and Liminist painting.
Research: A study on the philosophical foundations of Liminism, listed on the website as published in Theatre Book Magazine, year 4, issue 4, winter 1404.
Languages: Persian and English.
For current biography and publication details, consult the official website.
